name: M7.DefaultQuery.literal_fiber
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (base : M7.Action.Recipe N) (g h : M7.Action.Record N), M7.Action.act g base = M7.Action.act h base → ((M7.DefaultQuery.feasible q base (M7.Action.act g base) ↔ M7.DefaultQuery.feasible q base (M7.Action.act h base)) ∧ M7.DefaultQuery.objective q (M7.Action.act g base) = M7.DefaultQuery.objective q (M7.Action.act h base))
guidance: Every label is computed from the literal pair: signature is actual M6 polynomial gcd, dimension twice its degree, distance actual M6.Final.quantumDistance, locality/radius from that same pair. Rewrite the image equality; class-sector term uses the common base and is constant. No unconnected label-oracle premise is present. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; retain exact target and default limits.
